name: add-new-tool
description: Create a new WordCountTool and register it in BuiltInTools.swift. Tests read_file to understand existing patterns, write_file to create the new tool, and edit_file to modify the registry.
task: Create a new tool called WordCountTool that counts words in a file. First, read Sources/Yrden/Tools/ReadFileTool.swift to understand the TypedTool pattern (it uses @Schema for args, has a pathValidator property, and implements execute()). Also read Sources/Yrden/Tools/BuiltInTools.swift to understand how tools are registered (each tool is a public let property, initialized in init(), and added to the 'all' computed property array). Then create the new tool file at Sources/Yrden/Tools/WordCountTool.swift following the same pattern as ReadFileTool: it should have a WordCountArgs struct with a 'path' field, a WordCountTool struct conforming to TypedTool with name 'word_count', a pathValidator property, and an execute method that reads the file and counts words. Finally, edit Sources/Yrden/Tools/BuiltInTools.swift to add the wordCount tool as a new property, initialize it in init(), and include it in the 'all' array.
